item.title: UniFi 5G
item.description:
📝 For tougher environments or deployments with poor indoor cellular coverage, the outdoor model maintains the same high performance cellular connectivity with improved antenna performance in a durable IP67 rated enclosure. Every device in the UniFi 5G lineup supports both physical SIMs and eSIM, giving you the freedom to choose your carrier and switch whenever needed with zero friction. All are equipped with dual SIM slots, with one SIM replaceable by eSIM, and are fully unlocked: any major carrier, any type of deployment, with one piece of hardware.
🔗 Read more: https://blog.ui.com/article/introducing-unifi-5g
